name: Pao'ka Swiftmountain
summary: Pao'ka Swiftmountain is a young tauren naturalist stranded among the wild wyverns of Highperch in Thousand Needles. Having traveled south under the guidance of Motega Firemane, his youthful curiosity got the better of him when he ventured too close to a nesting site and ended up cornered in the cliffs.

sections.title: A Naturalist in Trouble
sections.body: Pao'ka came to the canyon country of Thousand Needles alongside Motega Firemane, eager to catalog and study the dangerous beasts of the canyons. His father had been reluctant to let his son go on such a perilous journey, and Pao'ka's recent misadventure proves those concerns were warranted. Fascinated by the magnificent wyverns inhabiting Highperch, the young scholar crept up the mountain trail behind a solitary tauren totem. Unsurprisingly, the territorial beasts took offense to his intrusion, driving him deep into the crags where he found himself trapped and terrified, unable to slip past the swooping predators to return to Whitereach Post.

aliases: who is the tauren at highperch
faq.answer: Pao'ka is a young tauren scholar who accompanied Motega Firemane to Thousand Needles to study regional wildlife, only to become trapped by territorial wyverns on Highperch.

faq.q: Where can Pao'ka Swiftmountain be found?
faq.answer: He is stranded atop Highperch in Thousand Needles. Reaching him requires finding a towering tauren totem near the cliffs, where a narrow path behind it climbs up the mountainside into the wyvern roosts.

faq.q: Why is he hiding in Highperch?
faq.answer: His fascination with wyverns led him too close to one of their nests. The angry beasts chased him away and cut off his retreat, forcing him into hiding for several days.

faq.q: What happens after you help him escape?
faq.answer: Once escorted safely out of the nesting grounds, Pao'ka flees back to Motega Firemane at Whitereach Post, desperately hoping his mentor will not report the blunder to his father.

angles.text: Pao'ka represents the next generation of tauren scholars exploring Kalimdor; keeping him alive maintains strong ties with the elders at Whitereach Post.
Wyverns are deeply revered by the tauren as allies and faithful mounts, making Pao'ka's poorly planned intrusion both embarrassing and dangerous.
